svg.text: 2 · Run it, stage by stage: build the method, analyse, evaluate
no: revise, or redo this stage
results contradict the plan → plan reopened; the change is recorded
saved to version history; never overwritten
The frozen plan: fixed before the result is scored
example: does a nitrogen-control gene switch on when bacteria are fed urea?
Hypothesis: the gene switches on with urea
Positive control: urea-use genes must switch on
Negative control: growth genes must stay flat
Statistics plan: no new test; the original study's verdicts
Decision rule: four outcomes, named in advance
Fair comparison: each strain vs its own control
History: decision rule committed and approved → control added → a reviewer saw one value → only the controls changed, disclosed → re-approved.
The researcher approves every plan and every stage; the AI never moves on alone.
